title: Weekly Hand-Curated Tech Jobs With Relocation: Week 78
body_html:
Hi everyone,

Time for a new weekly job list.

  • Back End – 3 roles (incl. 1 remote)

  • Full Stack – 1 role

  • Front End – 1 role

Back End

  • Senior Backend Engineer (Go)

    • Company: Trust Wallet (LinkedIn)

    • Industry and size: Web3 | 51–200 employees

    • Job keywords: Go, Microservice-based architectures, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes

    • Time zone: You can work any hours from anywhere

  • Senior Java Engineer

    • Company: Adyen (LinkedIn)

    • Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands

    • Industry and size: FinTech | 1K–5K employees

    • Job keywords: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka

    • Relocation support: Visa sponsorship and relocation package

  • Senior Backend Software Engineer

    • Company: Fingerprint (LinkedIn)

    • Industry and size: Device Intelligence | 51–200 employees

    • Job keywords: Golang, AWS, SQL, DynamoDB

Full Stack

  • Full Stack Engineer

    • Company: Metabase (LinkedIn)

    • Location: Berlin, Germany

    • Job keywords: Clojure, JavaScript, TypeScript

Front End

  • Frontend Engineer

    • Company: Trust Wallet (LinkedIn)

    • Job keywords: React, TypeScript
